New Car FAQs

Which are the most popular new cars available in Pakistan in 2026?

Popular new cars in Pakistan include Honda Civic, Suzuki Alto and Toyota Corolla.

Which are the most popular new car brands in Pakistan?

Popular new car brands in Pakistan include Honda, Toyota and Suzuki.

Are there any upcoming cars in Pakistan?

There are a total of 26 new car models expected to launch in Pakistan with 2026 Changan Lumin, 2026 GWM Cannon P300 and 2026 Geely EX2 launching soon.

Which brands offer electric cars in Pakistan?

Electric cars are offered by Audi, MG, and BMW in Pakistan.
